name: Elena Marsh
bio: Bought the first duplex in 2014 and sold both sides before the drywall went up. Still walks every site before we bid on it.

name: Priya Raman
bio: Runs feasibility and entitlement, and sits through the neighbourhood meetings that decide them. Trained as a landscape architect.

name: Daniel Okonjo
bio: Twenty years on site, the last nine running our own framing crews. Holds the schedule, and the punch list nobody else wants.

name: Marcus Bell
bio: Sells from drawings, which means he has to believe them first. Takes every buyer from the first walkthrough through to closing.
